answer.explanation: The agar plates (40 packs, $1,180) were rerouted from grant R21AI182745 to grant R01GM061721. The rule "Not in the grant's last 90 days" failed because R21AI182745 ends 2026-08-31, 77 days away, which matches the audit case of NSF OIG audits of WVU and Delaware, where supplies bought in a grant's last months were disallowed. Every rule passes on R01GM061721, so the order was placed with MicroMedia.
